oracleBoundary.use: These authenticated artifacts are oracle inputs only; they do not authorize reconstructed source, receipts, archives, or build claims.

deterministicFixtureFacts: ArchivalBundleTest.identical source trees produce byte-identical verified archives

archiveContract.productionQualification: Fixture determinism is not production full-driver evidence.

unavailableGates.reason: No accepted production reconstructed GCC driver tree or source manifest is retained.
No production archive, ARCHIVE_MANIFEST.sha256, complete ACP receipts, behavior reports, toolchain declaration, or unresolved inventory is retained as one payload.
The repository retains only synthetic fixture cross-root tests; no production archive pair or byte comparison is retained.
No credential-free, cache-free, network-isolated rebuild of an accepted production archive is retained.
Production resource measurements, diagnostics, and independent archive verification are unavailable.

analysisPolicy.ghidra: Production analysis must use the bundled Ghidra Java APIs in an isolated worker; GHIDRA_HOME and external analyzeHeadless are not production prerequisites.
analysisPolicy.unresolvedHandling: Unavailable production evidence remains unresolved and cannot count as an accepted archive or successful gate.
